RectTransform.description: Defines position, size, anchor, and pivot for UI elements. Auto-added to any child of a Canvas.

sizeDelta.description: Size relative to anchor distance. For point-anchors this is the element size.

offsetMin.description: Offset of lower-left corner from anchored position.

offsetMax.description: Offset of upper-right corner from anchored position.

Canvas.description: Root component for UI rendering. Required for all UI elements. Usually one per scene.

CanvasScaler.description: Controls UI element scaling. Typically set to ScaleWithScreenSize with a reference resolution.

GraphicRaycaster.description: Enables UI event detection (clicks, drags). Required on Canvas for interactive UI.

Image.description: Displays a sprite image. Most common UI visual component. Supports Simple/Sliced/Tiled/Filled modes.

maskable.description: Can be masked by parent Mask.

RawImage.description: Displays a raw Texture2D. Use for non-sprite textures, render textures, or video frames.

Text.description: Legacy text component. Consider TextMeshProUGUI for better quality. Displays plain text.

alignment.description: UpperLeft(0), UpperCenter(1), UpperRight(2), MiddleLeft(3), MiddleCenter(4), MiddleRight(5), LowerLeft(6), LowerCenter(7), LowerRight(8)

TextMeshProUGUI.description: High-quality text rendering (TextMeshPro). Recommended over legacy Text. Requires TMP package.

alignment.description: TopLeft, Top, TopRight, Left, Center, Right, BottomLeft, Bottom, BottomRight, etc.

overflowMode.description: Overflow (0), Ellipsis (1), Masking (2), Truncate (3), ScrollRect (4), Page (5)

Button.description: Clickable button. Requires a Graphic component (Image) on same or child object for visuals.

Toggle.description: Checkbox/toggle component. Use ToggleGroup for radio-button behavior.

Slider.description: Draggable slider for numeric value selection.

ScrollRect.description: Scrollable container. Requires a content RectTransform child and optional viewport with Mask.

InputField.description: Legacy text input field. Consider TMP_InputField for better quality.

contentType.description: Standard(0), Autocorrected(1), IntegerNumber(2), DecimalNumber(3), Alphanumeric(4), Name(5), EmailAddress(6), Password(7), Pin(8), Custom(9)

options.description: List of options. Set via script.

captionText.description: Text component for selected option display.

VerticalLayoutGroup.description: Arranges children vertically (top to bottom). Auto-positions and optionally auto-sizes children.

padding.description: Padding inside the layout. {left, right, top, bottom}.

childAlignment.description: UpperLeft(0), UpperCenter(1), UpperRight(2), MiddleLeft(3), MiddleCenter(4), MiddleRight(5), LowerLeft(6), LowerCenter(7), LowerRight(8)

HorizontalLayoutGroup.description: Arranges children horizontally (left to right). Same properties as VerticalLayoutGroup.

GridLayoutGroup.description: Arranges children in a grid pattern.

ContentSizeFitter.description: Auto-sizes RectTransform based on content (LayoutElement or child layout).

LayoutElement.description: Provides layout properties for LayoutGroup children. Controls min/preferred/flexible sizes.

Mask.description: Clips children to parent Image shape. Requires Image component on same object.

RectMask2D.description: Rectangular clipping mask. More efficient than Mask. No Image component needed.

Transform.description: Every GameObject has a Transform. Position, rotation, and scale in 3D space.

Rigidbody.description: 3D physics body. Enables gravity, forces, and collisions.

constraints.description: Freeze position/rotation axes. FreezePositionX=2, Y=4, Z=8, RotX=16, RotY=32, RotZ=64

MeshCollider.description: Mesh-shaped collision. Convex for dynamic objects, concave for static.

convex.description: Use convex hull. Required for Rigidbody.

CharacterController.description: Character movement controller with built-in capsule collider. Does not use Rigidbody.

Camera.description: Renders a view of the scene. Main Camera tagged 'MainCamera'.

MeshFilter.description: Holds mesh data for MeshRenderer. Pair with MeshRenderer for 3D visuals.

sharedMesh.description: Mesh asset. Built-in: Cube, Sphere, Capsule, Cylinder, Plane, Quad.

MeshRenderer.description: Renders mesh from MeshFilter with materials.

AudioSource.description: Plays audio clips. Supports 2D and 3D spatial audio.

Animator.description: Controls Mecanim animations via AnimatorController state machine.

ParticleSystem.description: Particle effect system. Configure via sub-modules (main, emission, shape, etc.).

EventSystem.description: Required for UI interaction. One per scene. Handles input routing to UI elements.

StandaloneInputModule.description: Input module for standalone platforms. Usually paired with EventSystem.

CanvasGroup.description: Controls alpha, interactability, and raycasting for a group of UI elements. Essential for fade-in/out effects.

ToggleGroup.description: Groups Toggles for radio-button behavior. Only one Toggle can be active at a time.

allowSwitchOff.description: Allow all toggles to be off.

Scrollbar.description: Scrollbar control, typically used with ScrollRect.

Rigidbody2D.description: 2D physics body. Enables gravity, forces, and collisions in 2D space.

PolygonCollider2D.description: Polygon-shaped 2D collision area. Auto-generated from sprite shape.

CompositeCollider2D.description: Merges child colliders (Box/Polygon with usedByComposite=true) into one optimized shape. Requires Rigidbody2D.

EdgeCollider2D.description: Open-ended edge chain 2D collision. Good for terrain surfaces.

SpriteRenderer.description: Renders a Sprite in 2D space. Primary component for 2D game visuals.

SpriteMask.description: Masks SpriteRenderers based on sprite alpha. Controls visibility via sorting layers.

alphaCutoff.description: Alpha below this is masked out.

Tilemap.description: Stores and renders tile data on a grid. Child of Grid GameObject. Core of Unity 2D tilemap system.

orientation.description: XY (0), XZ (1), YX (2), YZ (3), ZX (4), ZY (5), Custom (6)

TilemapRenderer.description: Renders tiles from a Tilemap component. Supports chunk or individual mode.

TilemapCollider2D.description: Generates 2D colliders from tilemap tile shapes. Use with CompositeCollider2D for performance.

maximumTileChangeCount.description: Max tile changes before full rebuild.

Grid.description: Parent grid for Tilemap components. Defines cell layout and sizing.

cellSwizzle.description: XYZ (0), XZY (1), YXZ (2), YZX (3), ZXY (4), ZYX (5)

LineRenderer.description: Renders a polyline in world space. Good for laser beams, paths, drawing lines.

numCornerVertices.description: Vertices at corners for smooth bends.

TrailRenderer.description: Renders a trail behind a moving object. Good for motion effects, bullets, particles.

SkinnedMeshRenderer.description: Renders a mesh deformed by bones/blend shapes. Used for animated characters.

LODGroup.description: Level of Detail controller. Switches renderers based on screen size for performance.

ReflectionProbe.description: Captures environment reflections for nearby objects. Baked or realtime.

boxProjection.description: Enable box projection for indoor scenes.

LightProbeGroup.description: Defines positions for light probes that capture lighting for dynamic objects.

NavMeshAgent.description: AI pathfinding agent on NavMesh. Automatically navigates around obstacles.

NavMeshObstacle.description: Dynamic obstacle that affects NavMesh pathfinding. Agents navigate around it.

OffMeshLink.description: Connects two NavMesh surfaces for jumping, climbing, or teleporting.

HingeJoint.description: Connects two Rigidbodies with a hinge. Good for doors, pendulums, chains.

SpringJoint.description: Spring connection between two Rigidbodies. Maintains distance with spring force.

FixedJoint.description: Locks two Rigidbodies together. Like welding objects. Can break under force.

ConfigurableJoint.description: Highly customizable joint. Can simulate any joint type by configuring per-axis motion/rotation locks.

HingeJoint2D.description: 2D hinge joint. Connects two Rigidbody2D with a pivot point.

SpringJoint2D.description: 2D spring joint. Maintains distance with spring force.

DistanceJoint2D.description: 2D distance constraint. Keeps two points at a fixed distance.

Terrain.description: Large-scale terrain rendering with heightmap, textures, trees, and grass.

TerrainCollider.description: Collision for Terrain heightmap. Auto-generated from terrain data.

VideoPlayer.description: Plays video clips or URLs. Can render to Camera, RenderTexture, or Material.

aspectRatio.description: NoScaling (0), FitVertically (1), FitHorizontally (2), FitInside (3), FitOutside (4), Stretch (5)

PlayableDirector.description: Controls Timeline playback. Drives animations, audio, and custom tracks.

WindZone.description: Affects Terrain trees, grass, and particle systems with wind force.

AudioListener.description: Receives audio in the scene. Usually attached to Main Camera. Only one active per scene.

AudioReverbZone.description: Defines an area with reverb effects. Good for caves, rooms, outdoors.

reverbPreset.description: Off(0), Generic(1), PaddedCell(2), Room(3), Bathroom(4), Livingroom(5), StoneRoom(6), Auditorium(7), ConcertHall(8), Cave(9), Arena(10), Hangar(11), CarpetedHallway(12), Hallway(13), StoneCorridor(14), Alley(15), Forest(16), City(17), Mountains(18), Quarry(19), Plain(20), ParkingLot(21), SewerPipe(22), Underwater(23), User(24)

dialog.name: Dialog / Modal Panel
dialog.description: Centered popup dialog with title, content, and button row.
dialog.structure:
Canvas
  └─ DialogRoot (Image, center-anchored, size: 500x400)
       ├─ Title (TextMeshProUGUI, top area, fontSize: 28)
       ├─ Content (TextMeshProUGUI or ScrollRect, middle area)
       └─ ButtonGroup (HorizontalLayoutGroup, bottom area, spacing: 10)
            ├─ CancelBtn (Image+Button, 120x40)
            │    └─ Text (TextMeshProUGUI)
            └─ ConfirmBtn (Image+Button, 120x40)
                 └─ Text (TextMeshProUGUI)
dialog.notes: DialogRoot: anchorMin/Max=(0.5,0.5), pivot=(0.5,0.5). Use VerticalLayoutGroup on DialogRoot for auto-layout, or manually position children.

scroll_list.name: Scrollable List
scroll_list.structure:
Canvas
  └─ ScrollView (ScrollRect + Image + RectMask2D, stretch or fixed size)
       ├─ Viewport (RectMask2D, stretch to parent)
       │    └─ Content (VerticalLayoutGroup + ContentSizeFitter[verticalFit=PreferredSize])
       │         ├─ Item1 (Image, LayoutElement[preferredHeight=60])
       │         ├─ Item2 ...
       │         └─ ItemN ...
       └─ Scrollbar (optional, Scrollbar component)
scroll_list.notes: ScrollRect.content = Content transform. ScrollRect.viewport = Viewport transform. Content anchor: top-stretch (min=0,1 max=1,1 pivot=0.5,1) so it grows downward.

tab_bar.name: Tab Bar Navigation
tab_bar.description: Horizontal tab buttons with content area below.
tab_bar.structure:
Canvas
  └─ TabContainer (stretch or fixed)
       ├─ TabBar (HorizontalLayoutGroup, top area, height: 50)
       │    ├─ Tab1 (Image+Button, LayoutElement)
       │    │    └─ Text
       │    ├─ Tab2 ...
       │    └─ Tab3 ...
       └─ ContentArea (below TabBar, stretch remaining space)
            ├─ Page1 (active/inactive toggle)
            ├─ Page2 ...
            └─ Page3 ...
tab_bar.notes: Control tab switching via script: activate one Page and deactivate others. Use Toggle+ToggleGroup for tab state management.

hud.name: HUD (Heads-Up Display)
hud.description: Game UI overlay with health, score, mini-map, and action buttons.
hud.structure:
Canvas
  └─ HUD
       ├─ TopBar (anchor: top-stretch)
       │    ├─ HealthBar (Image[Filled], left side)
       │    │    └─ HealthText (TextMeshProUGUI)
       │    └─ ScoreText (TextMeshProUGUI, right side)
       ├─ MiniMap (Image, anchor: top-right, size: 150x150)
       │    └─ MapContent (RawImage or custom)
       └─ BottomBar (anchor: bottom-stretch)
            └─ ActionButtons (HorizontalLayoutGroup, center)
                 ├─ Btn1 (Image+Button, 60x60)
                 ├─ Btn2 ...
                 └─ Btn3 ...
hud.notes: Anchor TopBar to top, BottomBar to bottom, MiniMap to top-right corner. Use offsetMin/offsetMax for margins from screen edges.

settings_form.name: Settings / Form
settings_form.description: Vertically arranged form with labels and controls.
settings_form.structure:
Canvas
  └─ SettingsPanel (Image, center-anchored or stretch)
       └─ Content (VerticalLayoutGroup, padding: 20, spacing: 15)
            ├─ Header (TextMeshProUGUI, fontSize: 28)
            ├─ Row1 (HorizontalLayoutGroup)
            │    ├─ Label (TextMeshProUGUI, 'Volume')
            │    └─ Slider (Slider, flex width)
            ├─ Row2 (HorizontalLayoutGroup)
            │    ├─ Label ('Difficulty')
            │    └─ Dropdown (Dropdown)
            ├─ Row3 (HorizontalLayoutGroup)
            │    ├─ Label ('Fullscreen')
            │    └─ Toggle (Toggle)
            └─ SaveButton (Image+Button, 200x50, center)
settings_form.notes: Use LayoutElement on Labels for fixed width (e.g., 150). Use flexible width on controls.

inventory_grid.name: Inventory Grid
inventory_grid.description: Grid of item slots, typically in a scroll view.
inventory_grid.structure:
Canvas
  └─ InventoryPanel (Image, center-anchored)
       ├─ Title (TextMeshProUGUI)
       └─ ScrollView (ScrollRect + RectMask2D)
            └─ Viewport
                 └─ Content (GridLayoutGroup, cellSize: 80x80, spacing: 5)
                      ├─ Slot1 (Image + Button)
                      │    ├─ Icon (Image)
                      │    └─ Count (TextMeshProUGUI)
                      ├─ Slot2 ...
                      └─ SlotN ...
inventory_grid.notes: GridLayoutGroup.constraint=FixedColumnCount for consistent columns. Content anchor: top-stretch, ContentSizeFitter verticalFit=PreferredSize.

toast.name: Toast / Notification
toast.description: Brief auto-dismissing message popup, typically at top or bottom of screen.
toast.structure:
Canvas
  └─ ToastContainer (anchor: top-center or bottom-center, CanvasGroup for fade)
       └─ Toast (Image, size: 400x60, horizontal padding: 20)
            ├─ Icon (Image, 32x32, optional)
            └─ Message (TextMeshProUGUI, flex width, fontSize: 16)
toast.notes: Use CanvasGroup.alpha for fade-in/out animation. Auto-destroy via script after 2-3s. Stack multiple toasts with VerticalLayoutGroup on container. Use ContentSizeFitter for auto-width.

loading_screen.name: Loading Screen
loading_screen.description: Full-screen loading overlay with progress bar and tips.
loading_screen.structure:
Canvas (sortingOrder: 999)
  └─ LoadingScreen (Image, stretch_full, background color/image)
       ├─ Logo (Image, center, size: 200x200)
       ├─ ProgressBarBg (Image, bottom area, 600x20, dark color)
       │    └─ ProgressBarFill (Image[Filled, Horizontal], stretch_full, bright color)
       ├─ PercentText (TextMeshProUGUI, above bar, fontSize: 18)
       └─ TipText (TextMeshProUGUI, below bar, fontSize: 14, italic)
loading_screen.notes: Update ProgressBarFill.fillAmount (0-1) from loading code. Use CanvasGroup for fade-out when complete. Place on a separate Canvas with high sortingOrder to overlay everything.

health_bar.name: Health Bar / Progress Bar
health_bar.description: Reusable horizontal bar showing a value as filled portion.
health_bar.structure:
HealthBar (empty, size: 200x24)
  ├─ Background (Image, stretch_full, dark color, sprite: background)
  ├─ Fill (Image[type=Filled, fillMethod=Horizontal], stretch_full, green/red)
  ├─ Border (Image, stretch_full, outline sprite, raycastTarget=false)
  └─ ValueText (TextMeshProUGUI, center, fontSize: 14, optional)
health_bar.notes: Set Fill.fillAmount = currentHP / maxHP. For smooth animation, lerp fillAmount over time. Color-code: green > 60%, yellow 30-60%, red < 30%. Can also use Slider component for built-in handle support.

tooltip.name: Tooltip / Hover Info
tooltip.description: Small popup panel that follows cursor or appears near a UI element.
tooltip.structure:
Canvas
  └─ Tooltip (CanvasGroup, starts alpha=0)
       └─ TooltipPanel (Image, ContentSizeFitter[both=PreferredSize])
            └─ Content (VerticalLayoutGroup, padding: 10, spacing: 4)
                 ├─ Title (TextMeshProUGUI, fontSize: 16, bold)
                 └─ Description (TextMeshProUGUI, fontSize: 13, max width: 300)
tooltip.notes: Position via RectTransformUtility.ScreenPointToLocalPointInRectangle. Use CanvasGroup for fade. Set pivot based on screen quadrant to avoid clipping. ContentSizeFitter auto-sizes to text. Disable raycastTarget on all children.

minimap.name: Minimap
minimap.description: Corner minimap showing top-down view of the game world.
minimap.structure:
Canvas
  └─ MinimapFrame (Image, anchor: top-right, size: 180x180)
       ├─ MinimapMask (Mask + Image[circle sprite])
       │    └─ MapView (RawImage, stretch_full, targetTexture: minimapRT)
       ├─ PlayerIcon (Image, center, 12x12, always-on-top)
       └─ Border (Image, stretch_full, decorative frame, raycastTarget=false)
minimap.notes: Use a separate Camera (cullingMask=MinimapLayer, orthographic=true) rendering to a RenderTexture. Update camera position to follow player. Rotate MapView or camera for rotating minimap. Use Mask with circle sprite for round minimap.

shop_store.name: Shop / Store
shop_store.description: Item purchase interface with categories, items grid, and detail panel.
shop_store.structure:
Canvas
  └─ ShopPanel (Image, center or stretch)
       ├─ Header (HorizontalLayoutGroup)
       │    ├─ Title (TextMeshProUGUI, 'Shop')
       │    ├─ CurrencyIcon (Image, 24x24)
       │    ├─ CurrencyText (TextMeshProUGUI)
       │    └─ CloseBtn (Button+Image, top-right)
       ├─ CategoryBar (HorizontalLayoutGroup, Toggle+ToggleGroup)
       │    ├─ WeaponsTab, ArmorTab, PotionsTab ...
       ├─ ItemsScrollView (ScrollRect)
       │    └─ Content (GridLayoutGroup, cellSize: 120x140)
       │         └─ ItemCard (Image+Button)
       │              ├─ ItemIcon (Image)
       │              ├─ ItemName (TextMeshProUGUI)
       │              └─ PriceTag (HorizontalLayoutGroup)
       │                   ├─ CoinIcon (Image)
       │                   └─ Price (TextMeshProUGUI)
       └─ DetailPanel (Image, right side or popup)
            ├─ ItemPreview, Description, Stats
            └─ BuyButton
shop_store.notes: Use Toggle+ToggleGroup for category tabs. Filter items by category in script. Highlight unaffordable items (dim or red price). DetailPanel updates on item selection.

leaderboard.name: Leaderboard / Rankings
leaderboard.description: Scrollable ranked list with player scores.
leaderboard.structure:
Canvas
  └─ LeaderboardPanel (Image, center-anchored, 500x600)
       ├─ Title (TextMeshProUGUI, 'Leaderboard', fontSize: 28)
       ├─ TabBar (HorizontalLayoutGroup: Daily/Weekly/AllTime)
       ├─ HeaderRow (HorizontalLayoutGroup, bold labels)
       │    ├─ Rank, Name, Score columns
       ├─ ScrollView (ScrollRect + RectMask2D)
       │    └─ Content (VerticalLayoutGroup, spacing: 2)
       │         └─ Row (HorizontalLayoutGroup, Image bg)
       │              ├─ RankText (TextMeshProUGUI, width: 50)
       │              ├─ Avatar (Image, 32x32)
       │              ├─ NameText (TextMeshProUGUI, flex)
       │              └─ ScoreText (TextMeshProUGUI, width: 100)
       └─ MyRankBar (Image, bottom, highlight color)
leaderboard.notes: Highlight current player row with different bg color. Top 3 ranks can use special icons (gold/silver/bronze). MyRankBar always visible at bottom showing player's own rank.

confirm_popup.name: Confirm Popup / Alert
confirm_popup.description: Simple yes/no confirmation dialog with optional icon.
confirm_popup.structure:
Canvas (sortingOrder: 100)
  └─ Overlay (Image, stretch_full, color: rgba(0,0,0,0.5), blocks clicks)
       └─ Popup (Image, center, 400x250, CanvasGroup)
            ├─ Icon (Image, optional, 48x48, warning/error/info)
            ├─ Message (TextMeshProUGUI, center area, fontSize: 18)
            └─ ButtonRow (HorizontalLayoutGroup, bottom, spacing: 20)
                 ├─ CancelBtn (Image+Button, 120x40)
                 │    └─ Text ('Cancel')
                 └─ ConfirmBtn (Image+Button, 120x40, accent color)
                      └─ Text ('Confirm')
confirm_popup.notes: Use dark semi-transparent overlay to block interaction with background. CanvasGroup for popup fade-in animation. Set overlay's Button onClick to cancel for dismiss-on-background-click.

chat_message_list.name: Chat / Message List
chat_message_list.description: Scrollable message list with different alignments for sent/received.
chat_message_list.structure:
Canvas
  └─ ChatPanel (Image, stretch or fixed)
       ├─ MessageList (ScrollRect, flex area)
       │    └─ Viewport (RectMask2D)
       │         └─ Content (VerticalLayoutGroup, spacing: 8, padding: 10)
       │              ├─ ReceivedMsg (HorizontalLayoutGroup, childAlignment: MiddleLeft)
       │              │    ├─ Avatar (Image, 36x36)
       │              │    └─ Bubble (Image[Sliced], ContentSizeFitter, max width: 280)
       │              │         └─ Text (TextMeshProUGUI, fontSize: 14)
       │              └─ SentMsg (HorizontalLayoutGroup, childAlignment: MiddleRight)
       │                   └─ Bubble (Image[Sliced], different color)
       │                        └─ Text
       └─ InputBar (HorizontalLayoutGroup, bottom, height: 50)
            ├─ InputField (TMP_InputField, flex)
            └─ SendBtn (Button+Image, 50x40)
chat_message_list.notes: Content anchored top-stretch with ContentSizeFitter[vertical=PreferredSize]. New messages append to bottom. Auto-scroll to bottom on new message. Use LayoutElement with maxWidth on bubbles. Sent messages right-aligned via LayoutElement with flexibleWidth on left spacer.

center.desc: Centered on parent. sizeDelta = element size.

stretch_full.desc: Fill parent. offsetMin/offsetMax for margins. sizeDelta=(0,0) for exact fill.

top_center.desc: Top center. y offset goes downward (negative).

bottom_center.desc: Bottom center. y offset goes upward (positive).

left_center.desc: Left center. x offset goes rightward.

right_center.desc: Right center. x offset goes leftward (negative).

top_stretch.desc: Stretch horizontally at top. sizeDelta.y = height.

bottom_stretch.desc: Stretch horizontally at bottom. sizeDelta.y = height.

left_stretch.desc: Stretch vertically at left. sizeDelta.x = width.

right_stretch.desc: Stretch vertically at right. sizeDelta.x = width.

center_stretch_horizontal.desc: Stretch horizontally at vertical center. sizeDelta.y = height.

center_stretch_vertical.desc: Stretch vertically at horizontal center. sizeDelta.x = width.

uiDesignRules:
=== Unity UI Design Rules ===

## Coordinate System
- Unity UI uses RectTransform (not Transform) for all Canvas children
- RectTransform.anchoredPosition is RELATIVE to the anchor point
- Default anchors at (0.5, 0.5): position (0,0) = center of parent
- Y-axis: positive = up, negative = down
- X-axis: positive = right, negative = left

## Anchor Presets (anchorMin, anchorMax)
- Center: min=(0.5,0.5) max=(0.5,0.5) → position relative to center
- Stretch-Full: min=(0,0) max=(1,1) → use offsetMin/offsetMax for margins
- Top-Center: min=(0.5,1) max=(0.5,1) → y=0 at top edge, negative=down
- Bottom-Center: min=(0.5,0) max=(0.5,0) → y=0 at bottom edge, positive=up
- Left-Center: min=(0,0.5) max=(0,0.5) → x=0 at left edge, positive=right
- Top-Stretch: min=(0,1) max=(1,1) → stretches horizontally at top

## Sizing Guidelines
- Touch target minimum: 44x44 points (accessible design)
- Button minimum: 80x40
- Standard button: 160x40 to 200x50
- Large button: 300x60
- Icon button: 48x48 to 64x64
- Input field height: 40-50
- Font sizes: body=14-18, heading=24-36, title=36-48, small=10-12

## Spacing & Margins
- Small spacing: 4-8
- Medium spacing: 12-16
- Large spacing: 24-32
- Screen edge margin: 20-40
- Between sections: 24-40

## Hierarchy Best Practices
- Canvas (root) → Panels → Content elements
- Use Empty GameObjects as logical containers
- Name objects descriptively: 'LoginPanel', 'HealthBar', 'ScoreText'
- Group related elements under parent objects

## Layout Components Usage
- VerticalLayoutGroup: menus, lists, form fields
- HorizontalLayoutGroup: button rows, nav bars, toolbars
- GridLayoutGroup: inventories, grids, galleries
- ContentSizeFitter: auto-sizing text containers, scroll content
- LayoutElement: override sizes in layout groups

## Canvas Setup
- Canvas: renderMode=ScreenSpaceOverlay (default for 2D UI)
- CanvasScaler: ScaleWithScreenSize, referenceResolution matching your design
- GraphicRaycaster: required for click/touch detection
- EventSystem + StandaloneInputModule: required in scene (one only)

## Common Mistakes to Avoid
- Don't nest multiple Canvas components (use sub-canvases only when needed)
- Don't use world-space Transform.position for UI - use anchoredPosition
- Don't forget EventSystem when creating interactive UI
- Don't set very large sizeDelta on stretched elements (use offsets instead)

## Multi-Resolution & SafeArea
- Always use CanvasScaler with ScaleWithScreenSize for responsive UI
- matchWidthOrHeight: 0=match width (landscape games), 1=match height (portrait), 0.5=balanced
- Common reference resolutions: 1920x1080 (PC/console), 1080x1920 (mobile portrait), 2560x1440 (high-DPI)
- SafeArea (notch/cutout handling): get Screen.safeArea and apply as RectTransform offsets on a root container
- Test at multiple aspect ratios: 16:9, 18:9, 19.5:9, 4:3 (iPad)
- For tablets, consider wider margins and larger touch targets

## UI Performance Optimization
- Split UI into multiple Canvases by update frequency (static vs dynamic)
- Disable raycastTarget on non-interactive elements (decorations, labels, backgrounds)
- Minimize Canvas rebuilds: avoid changing text/layout every frame, batch updates
- Use RectMask2D over Mask when possible (no extra draw call)
- Avoid overlapping transparent UI elements (overdraw)
- Object pooling for dynamic lists (don't Instantiate/Destroy per item)
- CanvasGroup.alpha=0 is NOT the same as disabling — the Canvas still rebuilds. Use gameObject.SetActive(false) to fully disable
- TextMeshProUGUI is more efficient than legacy Text for complex text rendering

## Animation & Transitions
- Use CanvasGroup.alpha for fade effects (apply to parent to fade entire panel)
- Common UI animations: fade in/out, scale bounce (0→1.1→1), slide from edge
- DOTween / LeanTween for smooth UI tweens (anchoredPosition, sizeDelta, alpha, scale)
- Animation curves: EaseOutBack for popups, EaseInOutQuad for slides
- Duration guidelines: tooltips 0.15s, panels 0.25s, full-screen transitions 0.4s
- Avoid Animator for simple UI transitions (overhead); use script-driven tweens

## Accessibility & Localization
- Minimum font size: 12pt for body text, 10pt absolute minimum for labels
- Color contrast ratio: at least 4.5:1 for text (WCAG AA)
- Don't convey information by color alone — use icons or text labels too
- For localization: use TextMeshProUGUI, avoid fixed-size text containers (use ContentSizeFitter)
- Right-to-left (RTL) layout: set HorizontalLayoutGroup.reverseArrangement=true
- Leave 30-40% extra space for text expansion (English→German/French)
